modmenu.descriptionTranslation.litematic: Schematic holograms, area selection, verification, material lists, easy place and paste. Reads and writes .litematic files.
litematicaplus.screen.title: Litematica Plus
litematicaplus.conflict.label: Warning
litematicaplus.conflict.title: Litematica Plus is loaded together with Litematica
litematicaplus.conflict.body: Litematica Plus replaces Litematica %s, it is not an add-on for it. Both are in your mods folder right now: schematics can be drawn twice, the two mods catch the same keys and clicks, and ghosts, highlights and easy place may misbehave. Keep only one of them in the mods folder and restart the game.
litematicaplus.conflict.open_mods.help: Open the mods folder to remove Litematica.
litematicaplus.conflict.chat: Litematica Plus is loaded TOGETHER with Litematica %s, but it is meant to be used INSTEAD of it. This can break how schematics are drawn: keep only one of them in the mods folder.
litematicaplus.tab.overview.help: Summary of the selected schematic: progress, errors, quick switches and the layer.
litematicaplus.tab.schematics.help: The schematic file library: search, preview, place, export and delete.
litematicaplus.tab.placements.help: Schematics placed in the world: position, rotation, sub-regions, copy grid.
litematicaplus.tab.server.help: Shared server schematics through Syncmatica: load, share, remove.
litematicaplus.tab.layers.help: Show the schematic layer by layer and limit it along X and Z.
litematicaplus.tab.area.help: Select an area in the world and save it as a new schematic.
litematicaplus.tab.materials.help: How many of each block you need, how many you have and where the rest is stored.
litematicaplus.tab.replacements.help: Swap schematic blocks for others without changing the file.
litematicaplus.tab.verifier.help: List of building errors near you; a click highlights the spot in the world.
litematicaplus.tab.settings.help: All mod options by category. Hover an item to see what it does.
litematicaplus.tab.addons.help: Compatibility with other mods and the problem log.
litematicaplus.button.save.help: Apply and save the changed options.
litematicaplus.button.revert.help: Undo unsaved changes. Key bindings are not undone.
litematicaplus.error.session_read_only: Session file is from a newer version. Changes are not saved.
litematicaplus.error.tool_item: Unknown item. Enter an item ID such as minecraft:stick.
litematicaplus.overview.empty_hint: Pick a file to see it as a hologram where you stand.
litematicaplus.overview.browse.help: Open the library and pick a schematic to build.
litematicaplus.overview.manage.help: Fine-tune position, rotation and the top view.
litematicaplus.overview.footer: Tool: %s. Ctrl+Scroll switches mode, Alt+Scroll nudges, Alt+Click uses your position.
litematicaplus.layer.mode_button.help: Switch mode: whole schematic, one layer, layers below or above, a range.
litematicaplus.layer.axis_button.help: Change the axis the layers are cut along.
litematicaplus.layer.position.help: The layer number (coordinate on the chosen axis). You can type a number.
litematicaplus.schematics.search.help: Show only files whose name contains this text.
litematicaplus.schematics.empty_hint: Put .litematic, .schem, .nbt or Axiom .bp files into the schematics folder, then press Refresh.
Save a copy as .schem (WorldEdit, FAWE) next to the file.
litematicaplus.schematics.export_structu: Save a copy as a vanilla .nbt structure next to the file.
litematicaplus.schematics.export_bluepri: Save a copy as an Axiom blueprint (.bp) next to the schematic.
Save a copy as an Axiom blueprint straight into the Axiom blueprints folder, so it shows up in the Axiom blueprint browser.
litematicaplus.axiom.send.tip: Hands this placement to Axiom exactly where it stands, with the current layer and X/Z limits. Move or rotate it with the Axiom gizmo and confirm in Axiom; Axiom pastes it and keeps it in its undo history.
litematicaplus.axiom.select_placement.ti: Makes the placement's regions the Axiom selection, so Axiom tools and operations work on that area.
litematicaplus.axiom.take_selection.tip: Adds a box that covers the current Axiom selection. A selection of any shape becomes its bounding box.
litematicaplus.axiom.give_selection.tip: Makes the finished boxes the Axiom selection.
litematicaplus.axiom.save_clipboard.tip: Saves what you copied in Axiom as a .litematic file with the name above, keeping containers, signs and entities.
litematicaplus.axiom.missing: Axiom is not available: install Axiom or update Litematica Plus.
litematicaplus.axiom.inactive: Axiom is off in this world. Switch to creative or ask the server for Axiom access, then try again.
litematicaplus.axiom.busy: Still preparing the previous request for Axiom.
litematicaplus.axiom.nothing: Nothing to hand to Axiom: the visible part of the placement is empty.
litematicaplus.axiom.rejected: Axiom did not accept the request. Check the Axiom message in chat.
litematicaplus.axiom.send_failed: Could not hand the placement to Axiom: %s
litematicaplus.axiom.sent: Axiom placement ready: %s blocks. Confirm it in Axiom.
litematicaplus.axiom.sent_without_entiti: Axiom placement ready: %s blocks. %s rotated or mirrored entities were left out; paste them with Litematica Plus.
litematicaplus.axiom.selection_imported: Box added from the Axiom selection: %sx%sx%s.
litematicaplus.axiom.no_clipboard: The Axiom clipboard is empty. Copy something in Axiom first.
litematicaplus.axiom.clipboard_saved: Saved %s blocks from the Axiom clipboard to %s.
litematicaplus.schematics.delete.help: Delete the schematic file from disk. Press again to confirm.
litematicaplus.schematics.delete_confirm: Press again to delete the file for good.
litematicaplus.schematics.delete_hint: Click again to delete %s for good
litematicaplus.schematics.sort.name: Name
litematicaplus.schematics.sort.tip: Sort by: %s. Click to switch between name, size (schematic volume), file weight and date changed.
litematicaplus.error.export_too_large: The schematic is too large for this format
litematicaplus.schematics.place.help: Place the selected schematic at your feet and open the placement editor.
litematicaplus.schematics.open_folder.he: Open the current schematic folder in the file manager.
litematicaplus.schematics.refresh.help: Re-read the file list and retry failed previews.
litematicaplus.schematics.pick_hint: Select a file to see its size, block count and author.
litematicaplus.schematics.unreadable: This file could not be read: %s
litematicaplus.schematics.author: Author
litematicaplus.placements.empty_hint: A placement is a schematic positioned in the world. Load a file to create the first one.
litematicaplus.placements.none_selected_: Pick one from the list to move, rotate or paste it.
litematicaplus.placements.name: Placement name
litematicaplus.placements.name.help: The placement name shown in lists; the schematic file is not changed.
litematicaplus.placements.move_here.help: Move the placement corner to where you stand.
litematicaplus.placements.enabled.help: Show this placement. A hidden one is neither drawn nor checked.
litematicaplus.placements.locked.help: Prevent the placement from being moved, rotated or mirrored by accident.
litematicaplus.placements.paste.help: Place the whole schematic into the world (creative). Needs a second press.
litematicaplus.placements.reload.help: Re-read the schematic file from disk if it changed.
litematicaplus.placements.remove.help: Remove the placement from the world. The file stays. Needs a second press.
litematicaplus.placements.remove_confirm: Press again to remove the placement.
litematicaplus.placement.failed: The schematic could not be loaded: %s. Check the file, then press Reload.
litematicaplus.mirror.none.help: Switch mirroring: none, along Z, along X.
litematicaplus.mirror.left_right.help: Switch mirroring: none, along Z, along X.
litematicaplus.mirror.front_back.help: Switch mirroring: none, along Z, along X.
litematicaplus.area.empty_hint: Select the build with the tool in the world, or press New box and type the corners.
litematicaplus.area.add_box.help: Add another box to the new schematic.
litematicaplus.area.intro: Saves a build from the world into a schematic file.
litematicaplus.area.step2: Ctrl+scroll to Area mode. Left click: first corner, right click: second.
litematicaplus.area.step3: Type a file name below and press Save. It appears on the Schematics tab.
litematicaplus.area.step_note: Several boxes make one schematic of an uneven shape. Without the tool: New box on the left, then Here at each corner.
litematicaplus.area.remove_box.help: Remove the selected box from the selection.
litematicaplus.area.box_name.help: Box name; it becomes the sub-region name.
litematicaplus.area.here.help: Put this corner where you stand.
litematicaplus.area.file_name.help: File name of the new schematic (no extension).
litematicaplus.area.save.help: Save the selected boxes to a .litematic file.
litematicaplus.area.error_nothing: Nothing to save. Set both corners of a box and enter a file name.
litematicaplus.area.error_exists: %s already exists. Press Replace to overwrite it.
litematicaplus.area.error_capture: The area could not be read: %s
litematicaplus.area.error_write: The file was not written: %s. Check free space and folder permissions.
litematicaplus.materials.packed_hint: after «+»: packed in shulker boxes or the ender chest
litematicaplus.materials.ender_unknown: open your ender chest to count it
litematicaplus.replace.reset_all.help: Remove all swaps in this placement.
litematicaplus.replace.search.help: Find a replacement block by name or id.
litematicaplus.replace.no_blocks_hint: Blocks with contents, such as chests and signs, cannot be replaced.
litematicaplus.replace.pick_title: Pick a block on the left
litematicaplus.replace.pick_hint: Then choose what to build instead. Similar blocks are listed first.
litematicaplus.replace.nothing_found_hin: Try a shorter name or a block id like minecraft:stone.
litematicaplus.replace.no_placement_hint: Select a placement to choose replacement blocks for it.
litematicaplus.materials.sort.help: Change the order of the material list.
litematicaplus.materials.sort.name: name
Hide materials you already have enough of.
litematicaplus.materials.hide_ghosts.hel: Hide the ghosts of the selected material in the world, in every schematic. Verification and counters stay the same. Press again to show them.
litematicaplus.materials.hide_ghosts_pic: Select a material in the list first
litematicaplus.materials.empty_hint: Every block of this placement is already in place. Turn off Hide done to see the full list.
litematicaplus.materials.no_placement_hi: The material list counts what a placement still needs. Load a schematic to start.
litematicaplus.verifier.empty_hint: Loaded chunks match the schematic for the enabled categories.
litematicaplus.verifier.no_placement_hin: The verifier compares the world with a placement. Load a schematic to start.
litematicaplus.verifier.clear_focus.help: Remove the frame from the selected error in the world.
litematicaplus.verifier.unknown: %s blocks are in unloaded chunks and were not checked
litematicaplus.mismatch.missing.help: Show spots where the block is still missing.
litematicaplus.mismatch.extra.help: Show extra blocks where the schematic has air.
litematicaplus.mismatch.wrong_block.help: Show spots with a different block.
litematicaplus.mismatch.wrong_state.help: Show blocks with the wrong rotation or state.
litematicaplus.settings.summary: Changes are saved when you leave
litematicaplus.settings.search_tip: Type part of a setting name or what it does. Ctrl+F jumps here, Esc clears.
litematicaplus.settings.search_empty_hin: Try a shorter word, or clear the search to browse categories.
litematicaplus.settings.save_failed: Settings not saved. Check the config folder, then press Save again.
litematicaplus.option.render_enabled.tip: Main switch for ghosts, error highlight and frames of every schematic. While it is off, the HUD and pick block ignore schematics.
litematicaplus.option.render_ghost.tip: See-through blocks where the schematic is not built yet.
litematicaplus.option.render_overlay.tip: Colored outlines on faces of missing, extra and wrong blocks.
litematicaplus.option.ghost_color.tip: Color mixed into schematic ghost blocks. White keeps the original textures.
litematicaplus.option.missing_color.tip: Highlight for blocks the schematic needs but the world does not have yet.
Highlight for a different block standing where the schematic expects another.
Highlight for the right block with a wrong direction or other state.
litematicaplus.option.extra_color.tip: Highlight for blocks in the world where the schematic expects air.
litematicaplus.option.colors_reset.tip: Restores the ghost tint and all error highlight colors.
litematicaplus.settings.color_hint: Left and right arrows choose a color, Enter applies it.
litematicaplus.settings.color_field: Any color as RRGGBB, for example 2FC7FF.
litematicaplus.option.overlay_xray.tip: Error highlight stays visible through blocks.
litematicaplus.option.render_colliding.t: Draws the ghost of the expected block over a block that stands wrong.
Ghosts are drawn only where a different block or a wrongly oriented block stands, showing what it should be. Missing blocks are not drawn; the error highlight works as usual.
litematicaplus.option.render_block_entit: Ghosts of chests, signs, banners, heads and other blocks with a special model.
litematicaplus.option.lenient_states.tip: Properties that change by themselves are not errors: redstone power, plant age, leaf distance, lit furnaces.
litematicaplus.option.loose_blocks.tip: The verifier accepts a block of the same kind instead of the one in the schematic: stone for quartz, plain glass for stained, oak stairs for brick stairs with the same facing. Redstone parts, rails, falling blocks and blocks with contents stay strict.
litematicaplus.option.soil_interchangeab: Dirt counts as correct where the schematic has a grass block and the other way round. Easy place puts down dirt when you have no grass blocks, and nothing digs one out to place the other.
litematicaplus.option.inventory_highligh: Outlines the nearest missing and wrong blocks whose item is in your hotbar or inventory right now. Shulker box contents are not counted.
litematicaplus.option.placement_boxes.ti: Frames around placed schematics and their sub-regions.
litematicaplus.option.selection_boxes.ti: Frames of the areas selected with the tool for a new schematic.
litematicaplus.option.hud_enabled.tip: A panel with the progress of the selected schematic, its errors and missing materials.
litematicaplus.option.hud_position.tip: Drag the info panel anywhere on the screen or pick a corner.
litematicaplus.hud_layout.title: Info panel position
litematicaplus.hud_layout.hint: Drag the panel with the mouse. Arrow keys move it by 1 px, with Shift by 10 px. Esc or Done saves.
litematicaplus.hud_layout.placeholder: The panel shows here while a placement is selected or the tool is in your hand.
litematicaplus.option.hud_material_lines: How many missing materials the HUD lists. 0 hides the list.
litematicaplus.option.tool_item.tip: The item that works as the tool, for example minecraft:stick.
litematicaplus.option.default_author.tip: The author name written into new schematics. When empty, your player name is used.
litematicaplus.option.easy_place.tip: Right click on a ghost places the needed block with the right rotation and state.
litematicaplus.option.placement_restrict: Stops you from placing a block by hand where the schematic wants a different one. Works without easy place too. Shulker boxes, chests, crafting tables and other workstations may go where the schematic leaves air.
litematicaplus.option.pick_block.tip: Middle click on a ghost puts the needed block from your inventory into your hand.
litematicaplus.option.locked_slots.tip: Easy place, pick block and tool switching never put items into the marked hotbar slots; they may only select them. Click a number or press 1-9.
litematicaplus.option.paste_replace.tip: What happens to world blocks when pasting: replace everything, keep the world under schematic air, or fill empty space only.
litematicaplus.option.paste_block_entiti: Pasting also copies chest contents, sign text and other block data.
litematicaplus.option.paste_entities.tip: Pasting places the schematic's entities: item frames, paintings, armor stands, mobs. Only for direct paste in singleplayer.
litematicaplus.option.paste_commands.tip: How many commands a server paste sends per tick. Too many can get you kicked for spam.
litematicaplus.option.worker_threads.tip: Threads that build and check schematic sections. Auto uses half of the CPU cores, at most 6.
litematicaplus.option.mesh_uploads.tip: How many finished ghost sections are sent to the GPU per frame. More shows schematics faster but can stutter.
litematicaplus.option.snapshot_budget.ti: Microseconds per frame spent copying world blocks for checking. More checks faster but lowers FPS.
litematicaplus.hud.title: LITEMATICA+
litematicaplus.hud.render_failed: Rendering stopped after an error. See the log.
litematicaplus.message.confirm_fill: Click again to fill %1$s boxes (%2$s blocks) with %3$s
litematicaplus.message.confirm_replace: Click again to replace %3$s with %4$s in %1$s boxes (%2$s blocks)
litematicaplus.message.fill_no_block: Choose a block: Alt + middle click a block in the world
litematicaplus.message.replace_no_source: Choose what to replace: Alt + Shift + middle click a block in the world
litematicaplus.message.fill_look_at_bloc: Look at a block in the world
litematicaplus.message.no_placement: No placement selected. Open the menu and load a schematic.
litematicaplus.message.no_selection: No area selected. Set two corners first.
litematicaplus.message.placement_locked: Placement is locked. Unlock it in the Placements tab.
litematicaplus.message.placement_restric: That block does not belong here. Turn off Placement guard to place it anyway.
litematicaplus.message.item_has_data: %s is only in your inventory with contents or a name. Turn on «Use items with data» in easy place settings.
litematicaplus.message.easy_place_orient: Turn to face the way the block points, then try again
litematicaplus.message.creative_required: Paste and Delete need creative mode
litematicaplus.message.paste_busy: Another paste is running. Right click with the tool to cancel it.
litematicaplus.message.paste_sent: Done: commands sent for %1$s blocks, %2$s skipped
litematicaplus.message.paste_failed: Paste stopped because of an error. See the log for details.
litematicaplus.message.paste_rebuilding: The placement is still updating. Try again in a moment.
litematicaplus.option.tool_enabled.tip: The tool item selects areas, moves placements and changes layers.
litematicaplus.area.replace.help: The file exists: press to overwrite it.
litematicaplus.area.saved_partial: Saved %1$s blocks to %2$s, but %3$s chunks were not loaded and are missing. Move closer and save again.
litematicaplus.area.saved_voxy: Saved %1$s blocks to %2$s. %3$s unloaded chunks were taken from Voxy: blocks only, without chest contents, sign text or entities.
litematicaplus.area.unloaded_voxy: %1$s of %2$s chunks are not loaded. They will be taken from Voxy where it has seen them (blocks only, without chest contents and entities); the rest stays empty.
litematicaplus.area.unloaded_warning: %1$s of %2$s chunks in the selection are not loaded; they would be saved empty. Fly over them or save the area in parts.
litematicaplus.error.not_schematic: This is not a supported schematic file
litematicaplus.error.too_large: The schematic is too large to load

litematicaplus.error.too_many_states: The schematic uses too many different block states

litematicaplus.error.selection_memory: Not enough memory to save this selection: about %1$s MB needed, %2$s MB free. Give Minecraft more memory or split the area into several schematics.
litematicaplus.message.unknown_blocks: %1$s: %2$s block types are unknown to this game version and were left out
litematicaplus.message.newer_schematic: %s was saved by a newer game version and may look different
litematicaplus.message.confirm_paste_lay: Click again to paste %1$s, only the part inside the current layer and X/Z bounds
litematicaplus.message.confirm_delete: Click again to delete %1$s boxes (%2$s blocks)
litematicaplus.message.delete_too_large: The selection has %1$s blocks; the limit for Delete is %2$s
litematicaplus.message.no_command_permis: The server does not let you use %s
litematicaplus.message.paste_no_data: Container contents are not pasted through commands
litematicaplus.message.paste_slow: You are not an operator, so commands are sent slowly to avoid a spam kick
Press again to paste the schematic.
litematicaplus.placements.regions_button: The schematic's sub-regions: turn on, move or rotate each one.
litematicaplus.grid.button_off.help: Repeat the schematic as copies along the axes, e.g. for farms.
litematicaplus.grid.button_on.help: Set up the copy grid: how many repeats and the step on each axis.
litematicaplus.grid.title: GRID, COPIES: %s
litematicaplus.grid.step.help: Distance between copies. Auto uses the size of one copy.
litematicaplus.grid.reset.help: Remove all copies and keep one schematic.
litematicaplus.grid.hint: -X/+X set how many copies go each way along the axis; an auto step is the schematic size. Ghosts, verification, materials, easy place and paste cover every copy.
litematicaplus.grid.too_many: Too many copies: more than %s. Lower the repeats.
litematicaplus.region.title: SUB-REGION "%s"
litematicaplus.region.enabled.help: Show this sub-region and check and place its blocks.
litematicaplus.region.reset.help: Clear the sub-region's offset, rotation and mirroring.
litematicaplus.tab.zones.help: Split the schematic into parts for team building and share them with teammates.
litematicaplus.zones.columns.help: How many parts to split the schematic into along X.
litematicaplus.zones.rows.help: How many parts to split the schematic into along Z.
litematicaplus.zones.floors.help: How many floors to split the schematic into by height.
litematicaplus.zones.empty_hint: Set the split on the right: how many parts along X, along Z and how many floors.
litematicaplus.zones.no_placement_hint: Select a placement in the Placements tab to split it into zones.
litematicaplus.zones.set_split: Split the schematic into at least two parts to hand zones out to the team.
litematicaplus.zones.claim.help: Take the selected zone and tell your teammates.
litematicaplus.zones.release.help: Free your zone and tell your teammates.
litematicaplus.zones.focus.help: Show and build only the selected zone.
litematicaplus.zones.team_hint.help: Names of the players who get zone messages.
litematicaplus.zones.transport.message.h: How zone messages are sent. They never go to the public chat.
litematicaplus.zones.transport.team.help: How zone messages are sent. They never go to the public chat.
litematicaplus.zones.transport.custom.he: How zone messages are sent. They never go to the public chat.
litematicaplus.zones.command_hint.help: Your own command for messages; {text} is replaced by the text.
litematicaplus.zones.share.help: Send the zone split to your teammates so everyone has the same plan.
litematicaplus.zones.ask.help: Ask teammates who took which zone.
litematicaplus.zones.private_hint: Service messages only go out through %s and are hidden for teammates with the mod. The mod never writes to the public chat.
litematicaplus.zones.problem_offline: Join a world to reach your team.
litematicaplus.zones.problem_broadcast: %s writes to every player, so the mod will not use it. Pick private messages or team chat.
litematicaplus.zones.problem_no_team: Enter your teammates' names: private messages go to each of them.
litematicaplus.zones.problem_no_command: This server has no %s command. Pick another channel.
litematicaplus.zones.plan_sent: Zone plan sent to the team
litematicaplus.zones.asked: Asked the team who took which zones
litematicaplus.zones.plan_unknown: %s sent a zone plan for a schematic you do not have in the same spot
litematicaplus.state.loading_hint: The list appears when loading finishes.
litematicaplus.state.hidden_hint: Turn on Shown in Placements to check it.
litematicaplus.materials.locate_hint: click a row to find it in chests
litematicaplus.materials.locate_empty: Open your chests once so the mod remembers them, then click %s again
litematicaplus.materials.locate_off: Turn on Remember opened containers in Settings to find materials in chests
litematicaplus.settings.category.renderi: How ghosts, error highlight and frames look.
litematicaplus.settings.category.tools.h: The tool item, pasting, the schematic library and team play.
litematicaplus.settings.category.easy_pl: Easy place: pace, rotation, finishing blocks and item choice.
litematicaplus.settings.category.hotkeys: Mod keys. Click a row and press a key; Esc unbinds it.
litematicaplus.settings.category.perform: CPU and GPU load. Change these if the game stutters.
Which differences count as errors and what goes into the progress.
litematicaplus.settings.category.hud.hel: The on-screen info panel: on/off, position and contents.
litematicaplus.settings.category.breakin: Protects the build from accidental breaking and helps with digging.
litematicaplus.settings.category.materia: The material helper in chests and stock tracking.
key.litematicaplus.take_materials: Take materials from the open container
key.litematicaplus.hide_ghost: Hide the ghost block you look at
litematicaplus.hotkeys.tip: Click, then press a key or a mouse button other than the left one; hold Ctrl, Shift or Alt for a combination (for example Ctrl + K). To bind Alt alone, press and release it. Esc clears the binding, a left click cancels.
litematicaplus.message.no_ghost_target: Look at a ghost block to hide it
litematicaplus.message.easy_place_restri: Easy place is on: blocks go only where the schematic wants them. Aim at a ghost block.
litematicaplus.message.observer_wait: The observer waits for the block it watches
litematicaplus.message.clearing: Breaking %s to place the right block
litematicaplus.message.clear_timeout: The block in the way could not be broken
litematicaplus.message.guard_outside: Excavation guard: this block is outside the schematic
litematicaplus.message.guard_correct: Excavation guard: this block is already correct
litematicaplus.option.easy_place_hold.ti: Keep the use button held and sweep over ghost blocks. When off, one press places one block.
Ticks between placements. Balanced 2, Safe 4 for strict anti-cheats, Fast 1, Custom uses the delay next to it.
litematicaplus.option.easy_place_delay.t: Used when the pace is Custom.
Adds 0 or 1 tick at random between placements so the rhythm is less mechanical.
litematicaplus.option.easy_place_fake_ro: Sends the needed look direction to the server, so stairs, pistons and observers face the way the schematic wants while your camera stays still.
litematicaplus.option.easy_place_lead.ti: How many ticks before the click the turn is sent. Raise it if the server places blocks facing the wrong way.
Sends your real look direction back right after the click.
Skips a block when no click can give it the schematic orientation. When off, the block is placed anyway.
litematicaplus.option.easy_place_air.tip: Allows clicks on faces you cannot see and on air. Needed for floating blocks; some anti-cheats reject such clicks.
Extra clicks after placing: repeater delay, comparator mode, lever, open trapdoors, doors and gates, double slabs, candles, note pitch.
litematicaplus.option.easy_place_ignite: Light and put out candles and campfires
Easy place lights candles, candle cakes and campfires with flint and steel or a fire charge, puts out campfires with a shovel and candles with an empty hand.
litematicaplus.option.easy_place_waterlo: Easy place fills waterlogged blocks with a water bucket and drains them with an empty bucket when the schematic says so. Off by default: a missed aim can pour water next to the block.
litematicaplus.message.shovel_missing: No shovel to put out the campfire
litematicaplus.message.no_empty_hand: Free a hotbar slot to put out the candle
litematicaplus.option.easy_place_interac: A click on a chest, furnace, crafting table or another block with a menu opens it, even with a schematic ghost in front of it; Shift+click places the ghost instead. When off, such clicks inside the schematic are blocked.
litematicaplus.option.easy_place_restric: While easy place is on, a block in hand cannot be placed by hand inside a placement or within 2 blocks of it. Shulker boxes, chests, crafting tables, furnaces and other workstations can still go where the schematic leaves air.
litematicaplus.option.easy_place_observe: An observer is placed only after the block it watches, so it does not fire.
litematicaplus.option.easy_place_ignore_: Also takes renamed items and items with stored contents. When off, only plain items are used.
litematicaplus.option.easy_place_diagnos: Shows above the hotbar why a block was not placed.
litematicaplus.option.easy_place_substit: When the exact block is missing, places another gate, trapdoor or coral fan of the same kind, or a block from your substitute list.
litematicaplus.option.substitutes_add.ti: Adds the block in your main hand to the substitute list. The number is the list size.
Remove every item from the substitute list.
litematicaplus.settings.substitute_rejec: Hold a block that is not in the list yet
litematicaplus.option.entity_placement.t: Item frames with their item and rotation, paintings and armor stands with armor. Aim at the marker and use.
litematicaplus.option.excavation_guard.t: While easy place is on, stops you from breaking blocks the build needs. The two rules below choose which ones.
litematicaplus.option.tool_use_guard: Do not spoil schematic blocks with tools
litematicaplus.option.tool_use_guard.tip: Right-click with a shovel, hoe or axe on a block inside a placement is cancelled when it would turn the block into something the schematic does not ask for: grass into a path, dirt into farmland, a log into a stripped log.
litematicaplus.message.tool_guarded: Kept %s as in the schematic: the tool would change it
litematicaplus.option.excavation_guard_o: Blocks outside every shown schematic cannot be broken. Chests, shulker boxes, crafting tables, doors and other functional blocks still can.
litematicaplus.option.excavation_guard_c: Blocks that already match the schematic cannot be broken.
litematicaplus.option.excavation_guard_h: Explains above the hotbar why the protection did not let you break a block.
litematicaplus.option.auto_tool_switch.t: Before a block inside an enabled placement starts breaking, takes the best tool from your inventory. Works without easy place too.
litematicaplus.option.terrain_auto_repla: Digs out dirt, grass, coarse dirt or a path standing where the schematic has another of them and puts the right one. With interchangeable dirt and grass those two are left alone.
litematicaplus.option.break_wrong_blocks: A different block, or the right block facing the wrong way, is mined and placed again. Containers, workstations (crafting tables, furnaces, anvils), ender chests, lecterns, jukeboxes, beacons, spawners, liquids and unbreakable blocks are never touched.
litematicaplus.option.note_tuning_hud.ti: While you tune the note blocks of a schematic, the HUD shows how many are left.
litematicaplus.option.material_helper.ti: In chests, barrels, shulker boxes, ender chests, hoppers, dispensers and on donkeys and llamas highlights the items the build still needs.
litematicaplus.option.material_follows_r: While schematics are hidden or the selected placement is disabled, the info panel shows nothing about it, and the material panel next to containers, the highlight in containers and the tooltip lines are not shown either.
litematicaplus.option.material_panel.tip: A side panel lists what the selected placement still needs, how much of it this container holds and how much you carry. Click a line to take that item.
litematicaplus.option.material_exact.tip: Takes and puts back exact amounts instead of whole stacks by splitting a stack with a few clicks. Off: whole stacks only.
litematicaplus.layers.layer_here.help: Move the layer to the coordinate of your feet.
litematicaplus.layers.from.help: Lower bound of the layer range.
litematicaplus.layers.to.help: Upper bound of the layer range.
litematicaplus.layers.clip_enabled.help: Clip the schematic to the X and Z bounds below.
litematicaplus.layers.fit_placement.help: Take the X and Z bounds from the selected placement.
litematicaplus.layers.fit_selection.help: Take the X and Z bounds and a Y layer range from the tool's area selection.
litematicaplus.layers.reset.help: Remove the X and Z limits.
litematicaplus.layers.here.help: Set this bound from your position.
litematicaplus.layers.hint: Ghosts, error highlights, easy place, pick block and Jade work only inside the layer and the X/Z bounds. With the option above, progress, counters and the material list count only that part too. Bounds are kept per world; F7 opens this tab.
litematicaplus.option.count_visible_only: When a layer or X/Z bounds are set, progress, counters and the material list count only blocks inside them.
Shows a 3D picture of the selected schematic in the Schematics and Placements tabs. Drag to rotate, right drag to pan, scroll to zoom.
litematicaplus.option.preview_models.tip: Draws previews with real block models and textures. Off: flat colored cubes, faster for huge schematics. Very large schematics always use cubes.
litematicaplus.preview.controls: Drag: rotate. Right drag: pan. Wheel: zoom. Double-click: reset.
Item tooltips say how many more the selected placement needs, and shulker box tooltips list the needed items inside. Works next to ShulkerBoxTooltip.
litematicaplus.option.ender_chest_materi: Count the ender chest in materials
Items in your ender chest are added to Have in the material list and on the info panel. Open the ender chest once after joining so the mod can see it.
litematicaplus.option.container_memory.t: Remembers what lies in chests, barrels and shulker boxes you open in this world during this session. Click a material in the Materials tab to light up the containers that hold it.
litematicaplus.option.container_highligh: Outlines remembered containers within 64 blocks, through walls, that hold a material you still lack in your inventory for the selected schematic.
litematicaplus.option.material_swap.tip: Blocks chosen on the Replacements tab take the place of the schematic's blocks in ghosts, the verifier, the material list, easy place and paste. The file itself is not changed.
litematicaplus.placements.edit.help: Open the editor: drag with the mouse, top view, paste.
litematicaplus.editor.title: Placement editor
litematicaplus.editor.step.help: How many blocks the arrows and buttons move.
litematicaplus.editor.locked.help: Protect the placement from accidental moves.
litematicaplus.editor.top_view.help: Look at the schematic from above and drag it (T).
litematicaplus.editor.menu.help: Open the mod menu on the placements tab.
litematicaplus.editor.coordinate_tip: Click and type the coordinate, Enter applies it. Ctrl+V pastes three numbers such as 2000 64 -350.
litematicaplus.editor.nudge_tip: Move along %s. Hold Shift for 10 steps.
litematicaplus.editor.hint: Drag with the left button to move the schematic. Wheel changes height. Arrows and PgUp/PgDn nudge it, R turns, M mirrors, T looks from above.
litematicaplus.editor.hint_top: Left drag moves the schematic, right drag moves the view, the wheel zooms. T returns to your own view.
litematicaplus.materials.export.help: Save the material list to a file or copy it.
litematicaplus.materials.export_clipboar: Copy the visible list to the clipboard (for spreadsheets).
litematicaplus.materials.export_empty: The list is empty, there is nothing to save
litematicaplus.panel.title: Schematic: %s
litematicaplus.panel.take_all.tip: Moves what the placement still needs from this container into your inventory. Shulker boxes are taken whole when loose items are not enough.
litematicaplus.panel.deposit.tip: Puts schematic materials you carry beyond what is still needed into this container. The item in your hand and slots locked in Inventory Profiles Next are kept.
litematicaplus.panel.collapse.tip: Collapse the panel to its title. Useful container slots stay highlighted.
litematicaplus.panel.tip.boxed: Inside shulker boxes here: %s (taken as whole boxes)
litematicaplus.panel.tip.click: Click: take what is needed. Shift+click: take all of it from here.
litematicaplus.panel.tip.calculator: Right click: show the amount in Stack Calculator
litematicaplus.panel.busy: Items are still moving, wait a moment
litematicaplus.panel.cursor_busy: Put down the item on your cursor first
litematicaplus.panel.empty.have_all: You already carry everything the placement still needs.
litematicaplus.panel.empty.complete: The placement is complete, nothing is missing.
litematicaplus.jade.extra: Extra block, the schematic has nothing here
litematicaplus.message.entity_random_pai: No painting item with this picture in the inventory, so the game picks one at random
litematicaplus.option.hud_diagnostics.ti: Two extra lines: sections drawn / ready / total, then queued, in work and rebuilt during the last second.
litematicaplus.option.render_distance.ti: How far from the camera ghost blocks are drawn, in blocks. Does not depend on loaded chunks.
litematicaplus.hud.diag_changes: Block updates inside placements, last minute: %1$s
litematicaplus.option.trust_hidden.tip: On servers with anti-xray the client receives fake blocks for everything buried inside other blocks. A wrong block that is covered on all six sides is therefore not reported. Does not apply in singleplayer.
litematicaplus.option.world_cache.tip: Where a chunk is not loaded, the schematic is checked against the blocks Voxy has stored, and saving a new schematic takes such chunks from Voxy too (blocks only). Needs Voxy and VoxyMap; without them those parts stay unknown and are drawn as ghosts.
litematicaplus.option.ghosts_loaded_only: Ghost blocks are drawn only where the game itself draws the terrain, so mountains and walls always cover them. When off, the schematic is also drawn beyond loaded chunks and can show through distant terrain from Voxy.
litematicaplus.server.empty_hint: Select a placement in the Placements tab, then press Share below.
litematicaplus.server.load.help: Download the shared schematic and show it.
litematicaplus.server.unload.help: Hide the shared schematic for you; it stays on the server.
litematicaplus.server.remove.help: Delete the shared schematic from the server for everyone. Needs a second press.
litematicaplus.server.remove_confirm.hel: Press again to delete it for all players.
litematicaplus.server.share_none.help: Upload the selected placement to the server so others can see it.
litematicaplus.server.share_already.help: Upload the selected placement to the server so others can see it.
litematicaplus.server.share_progress.hel: Upload the selected placement to the server so others can see it.
litematicaplus.server.share.help: Upload the selected placement to the server so others can see it.
litematicaplus.server.conflict_hint: The Syncmatica mod is installed, so this tab is off. Remove Syncmatica to share schematics from here.
litematicaplus.server.unavailable_hint: This server has no Syncmatica. It needs the Syncmatica Paper plugin (Paper, Purpur, Folia) or the Syncmatica mod on a Fabric server. The mod connects to it by itself when you join.
litematicaplus.server.connecting_hint: The server supports Syncmatica; agreeing on the protocol version…
litematicaplus.server.none_selected_hint: Pick a schematic in the list on the left.
litematicaplus.server.hint_editing: You are editing this placement: move it as usual, then lock it again to send the change to everyone.
litematicaplus.server.hint_loaded: Loaded and locked. To move it for everyone, unlock it in the Placements tab: the server lets one player edit at a time.
litematicaplus.server.hint_other_dimensi: This schematic is in another dimension. Go there to load it.
litematicaplus.server.hint_load: Press Load or double-click the row. If the file is not here yet, the mod downloads it from the server.
litematicaplus.share.connected: This server shares schematics (Syncmatica): %s right now. See the Server tab.
litematicaplus.share.shared: "%s" is now shared on the server.
litematicaplus.share.share_failed: The server did not accept "%s": you may lack permission or be over quota.
litematicaplus.share.too_large: "%s" is larger than %s MB and cannot be sent.
litematicaplus.share.other_dimension: "%s" is in dimension %s. Go there to load it.
litematicaplus.share.modify_unsupported: The server does not allow editing shared placements.
litematicaplus.share.modify_accepted: You can move "%s" now. Lock it again to send it to everyone.
litematicaplus.share.modify_sent: New position of "%s" sent to everyone.
litematicaplus.share.modify_denied: The server refused the edit: another player is editing it or you lack permission.
litematicaplus.share.removed: "%s" was removed from the server. You keep it as a normal placement.
litematicaplus.share.download_failed: Could not download "%s" from the server. Try again.
litematicaplus.share.server.error.cancel: Upload cancelled: your upload quota is used up.
litematicaplus.addons.copy_report.help: Copy mod and problem details, useful for a bug report.
litematicaplus.addons.no_problems_missin: The mod is not installed, so there are no problems. Install it if you want this integration.
litematicaplus.addons.more_problems: …and %s more. The report has the full list.
litematicaplus.addon.status.missing: Not installed. Litematica Plus works without it.
litematicaplus.addon.syncmatica.name: Syncmatica (shared schematics)
litematicaplus.addon.syncmatica.about: Server-wide shared schematics: share placements, download other players' ones and edit them one at a time. Needs the Syncmatica Paper plugin (Paper, Purpur, Folia) or the Syncmatica mod on the server. See the Server tab.
litematicaplus.addon.syncmatica.status.c: The separate Syncmatica mod is installed, so it handles shared schematics.
litematicaplus.addon.syncmatica.status.o: Turned off in settings: the mod does not answer the Syncmatica server.
litematicaplus.addon.syncmatica.status.a: Connected to the server (Syncmatica %s), shared schematics: %s.
litematicaplus.addon.syncmatica.status.r: The server runs a too old Syncmatica (%s); the connection was refused.
litematicaplus.addon.syncmatica.status.c: The server supports Syncmatica; agreeing on the version…
litematicaplus.addon.syncmatica.status.n: This server has no Syncmatica (or you are not on a server). The mod connects by itself when you join one that has it.
litematicaplus.addon.voxymap.name: VoxyMap (3D map)
litematicaplus.addon.voxymap.about: Schematics show on the 3D map, and unloaded sections are checked against Voxy data, so counters do not jump when chunks unload.
litematicaplus.addon.voxymap.status.acti: The map integration works. Turn on schematics on the map in VoxyMap settings.
litematicaplus.addon.voxymap.status.fail: VoxyMap is installed but its API was not found: update VoxyMap or Litematica Plus.
litematicaplus.addon.voxy.name: Voxy (distant terrain)
litematicaplus.addon.voxy.about: With Iris shaders the mod adds Voxy's distant terrain depth, so the schematic does not show through far mountains.
litematicaplus.addon.voxy.status.active: Works without Iris, no depth needed. %s
litematicaplus.addon.voxy.status.failed: Voxy depth could not be read: the schematic is hidden over unbuilt sections instead (fallback).
litematicaplus.addon.voxy.cache_on: Checking against the Voxy cache is available.
litematicaplus.addon.voxy.cache_off: Checking against the Voxy cache is unavailable (needs VoxyMap).
litematicaplus.addon.iris.name: Iris (shaders)
litematicaplus.addon.iris.about: The schematic is drawn after the final shader pass, and the top view pushes the shader pack fog back.
litematicaplus.addon.sodium.name: Sodium
litematicaplus.addon.sodium.about: When Voxy depth is not available, the mod asks Sodium whether a section is built and does not draw the schematic over empty space.
litematicaplus.addon.sodium.status.faile: Sodium is installed but section checks are unavailable: its API may have changed.
litematicaplus.addon.jade.name: Jade
litematicaplus.addon.jade.about: The Jade tooltip shows the schematic block you aim at and what is wrong with it.
litematicaplus.addon.jade.status.active: The plugin is registered with Jade.
litematicaplus.addon.jade.status.failed: Jade is installed but did not register the Litematica Plus plugin.
litematicaplus.addon.stack_calculator.ab: From the material panel you can send the needed amount to the stack calculator.
litematicaplus.addon.stack_calculator.st: The calculator button in the material panel works.
Stack Calculator is installed but its memory is unreachable: update one of the mods.
The material helper leaves slots locked in Inventory Profiles Next alone.
Locked slots could not be read: the helper may touch them.
litematicaplus.addon.mod_menu.name: Mod Menu
litematicaplus.addon.mod_menu.about: The Litematica Plus settings screen opens from the mod list.
litematicaplus.addon.mod_menu.status.act: The settings button in the mod list is available.
litematicaplus.addon.axiom.name: Axiom
litematicaplus.addon.axiom.about: Paste placements with Axiom, swap selections both ways, save the Axiom clipboard as a schematic and use .bp blueprints like any other schematic. While the Axiom editor is open, Litematica Plus stops intercepting clicks and hotkeys.
litematicaplus.addon.axiom.status.active: Axiom %s is connected and on in this world.
litematicaplus.addon.axiom.status.standb: Axiom %s is connected but off in this world: blueprints work, pasting and selections wait for Axiom access.
litematicaplus.addon.axiom.status.failed: Axiom %s is installed, but its internals were not found: update Axiom or Litematica Plus. Blueprints still work.
litematicaplus.addon.litematica.name: Litematica
litematicaplus.addon.litematica.about: Litematica Plus replaces Litematica rather than adding to it. Together they catch the same clicks and draw schematics twice.
litematicaplus.addon.litematica.status.c: Litematica %s is loaded together with Litematica Plus. Remove it from the mods folder.
litematicaplus.addon.problem.unreadable: Could not connect to the mod
litematicaplus.addon.problem.call_failed: A call into the mod failed
litematicaplus.addon.problem.lod_merge_f: Could not merge Voxy depth, fallback in use
litematicaplus.addon.problem.world_cache: Voxy data for checking is unavailable
litematicaplus.addon.problem.cache_unrea: Could not read the downloaded shared schematics folder
litematicaplus.addon.problem.rejected: Server refused: Syncmatica %s is too old
litematicaplus.option.syncmatica.tip: Answer servers that run the Syncmatica Paper plugin or the Syncmatica mod: share schematics, download other players' ones and edit them one at a time. When off, the server sees no shared schematics from you.
litematicaplus.option.zone_hide_messages: The [LP-zones] lines that zone members exchange are not shown in chat.
litematicaplus.option.axiom_editor_pause: Step aside in the Axiom editor
While the Axiom editor is open, the tool, easy place and Litematica Plus hotkeys do not react, so Axiom gets every click.
litematicaplus.placements.coordinate_tip: Coordinate of the placement corner. Click the number to type; Shift + «±» changes it by 10.
litematicaplus.grid.repeat_negative_tip: How many copies to add in the negative %s direction.
litematicaplus.grid.repeat_positive_tip: How many copies to add in the positive %s direction.
litematicaplus.region.offset_tip: Offset of the sub-region from its place in the schematic.
